item.description: The fire under Phylldoto Lysides ~1320 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.

item.title: Peislaos #9503 the Blood-handed took the staff in the Boule for the Argyreoi: "Hear me! Re
item.description: Peislaos #9503 the Blood-handed took the staff in the Boule for the Argyreoi: "Hear me! Remember the taking of the Fleece by Deucalion's Strand. I say: let the temples get their tithe. As the old poet says, a bad neighbour is as great a plague as a good one is a blessing." The assembly roared like the long waves of the Icarian sea.
